syllabus.title: AITS 01 Syllabus
syllabus.content:
📌 PHYSICS
• Vector & Calculus, Motion in a Straight line, Projectile Motion, Relative Motion Newton law of Motion, Friction, Work Power & Energy, Circular motion, Units & Measurement

📌 CHEMISTRY
• Some Basic Concepts Of Chemistry, Redox Reactions, Atomic Structure, States of Matter, IUPAC Nomenclature, Thermodynamics

📌 MATHEMATICS
• Basic Math & Logarithm, Quadratic Equations, Sequence & Series, Binomial Theorem, Trigonometric Ratio & Identities, Trigonometric Equation, Straight Lines, Circle, Parabola
